evaluation_protocol.success_definition: Episode reaches the configured time limit without early termination.
evaluation_protocol.failure_definition: Episode terminates before the configured time limit.

execution.environment_transitions_definition: vector_steps multiplied by num_envs; includes all simulated environments executed while collecting the requested benchmark episodes.

metric_definitions.success_rate: Fraction of counted benchmark episodes that survived until normal timeout.
metric_definitions.fall_rate: Fraction of counted benchmark episodes that terminated before normal timeout.
metric_definitions.linear_velocity_rmse_mps: XY velocity command tracking RMSE in the gravity-aligned robot yaw frame.
metric_definitions.yaw_velocity_rmse_radps: Yaw angular velocity command tracking RMSE using world-frame angular velocity.
metric_definitions.mean_base_tilt_degrees: Mean angular deviation from upright computed from projected gravity in the robot base frame.
metric_definitions.joint_limit_violation_rate: Fraction of joint-time observations whose joint position lies outside the configured soft joint-position limits.
